dz: 伯纳斯街的恶作剧由西奥多·胡克在伦敦威斯敏斯特市所为.
de: The Berners Street hoax is perpetrated by Theodore Hook in the City of Westminster, London.

t: 摩洛哥北部的地震摧毁了费斯和梅克内斯等城市.
te: An earthquake in northern Morocco devastates the cities of Fes and Meknes.
dz: 摩洛哥北部的地震摧毁了费斯和梅克内斯等城市.
de: An earthquake in northern Morocco devastates the cities of Fes and Meknes.

t: 柏林耶路撒冷教堂的奠基地被打下.
te: The foundation stone to the Jerusalem Church in Berlin is laid.
dz: 柏林耶路撒冷教堂的奠基地被打下.
de: The foundation stone to the Jerusalem Church in Berlin is laid.

t: 一群明朝宫女刺杀嘉靖皇帝失败，被慢斩处决。
te: A group of Ming dynasty palace women fail to murder the Jiajing Emperor, and are executed by slow-slicing.
dz: 壬寅年宫剧情：一群明朝宫女刺杀嘉靖皇帝失败，被慢斩处决。
de: Palace plot of Renyin year: A group of Ming dynasty palace women fail to murder the Jiajing Emperor, and are executed by slow-slicing.

t: 萨利赫·哈吉(Al-Salih Hajji)是最后一个卡拉武尼德苏丹被巴克克废黜,结束了长期突…
te: Al-Salih Hajji, the last Qalawunid sultan, is deposed by Barquq, ending the long Turkic Bahri Mamluk period in general …
dz: 萨利赫·哈吉(Al-Salih Hajji)是最后一个卡拉武尼德苏丹被巴克克废黜,结束了长期突厥克·巴赫里·马姆卢克时期的通称,尤其是卡拉武尼德王朝,开始了切尔克西人布尔吉·马姆卢克的统治.
de: Al-Salih Hajji, the last Qalawunid sultan, is deposed by Barquq, ending the long Turkic Bahri Mamluk period in general and particularly the Qalawunid dynasty, and beginning the reign of the Circassian Burji Mamluk.

t: 教皇乌尔班二世在克莱蒙议会宣布第一次十字军东征。
te: Pope Urban II declares the First Crusade at the Council of Clermont.
dz: 教皇乌尔班二世在克莱蒙议会宣布第一次十字军东征。
de: Pope Urban II declares the First Crusade at the Council of Clermont.

t: 拜占庭皇帝莫里斯被迫亲眼目睹篡位者福卡斯处决他的五个儿子，然后莫里斯被斩首。
te: Byzantine Emperor Maurice is forced to watch as the usurper Phocas executes his five sons before Maurice is beheaded hi…
dz: 拜占庭皇帝莫里斯被迫亲眼目睹篡位者福卡斯处决他的五个儿子，然后莫里斯被斩首。
de: Byzantine Emperor Maurice is forced to watch as the usurper Phocas executes his five sons before Maurice is beheaded himself.

t: 克洛维斯一世国王死在了卢特提亚并被安葬于圣吉纳维夫修道院.
te: King Clovis I dies at Lutetia and is buried in the Abbey of St Genevieve.
dz: 克洛维斯一世国王死在了卢特提亚并被安葬于圣吉纳维夫修道院.
de: King Clovis I dies at Lutetia and is buried in the Abbey of St Genevieve.

t: 鲁菲努斯,东部的普雷托里亚总督,被盖纳斯手下的哥特雇佣兵所谋杀.
te: Rufinus, praetorian prefect of the East, is murdered by Gothic mercenaries under Gainas.
dz: 鲁菲努斯,东部的普雷托里亚总督,被盖纳斯手下的哥特雇佣兵所谋杀.
de: Rufinus, praetorian prefect of the East, is murdered by Gothic mercenaries under Gainas.

t: 皇帝马库斯·奥雷利乌斯授予他的儿子科莫多斯"伊姆佩拉特"(Imperator)军衔,并让他出任…
te: Emperor Marcus Aurelius grants his son Commodus the rank of "Imperator" and makes him Supreme Commander of the Roman le…
dz: 皇帝马库斯·奥雷利乌斯授予他的儿子科莫多斯"伊姆佩拉特"(Imperator)军衔,并让他出任罗马军团的最高指挥官.
de: Emperor Marcus Aurelius grants his son Commodus the rank of "Imperator" and makes him Supreme Commander of the Roman legions.

t: 汉光武帝定都洛阳，为东汉王朝的首都。
te: Luoyang is declared capital of the Eastern Han dynasty by Emperor Guangwu of Han.
dz: 汉光武帝定都洛阳，为东汉王朝的首都。
de: Luoyang is declared capital of the Eastern Han dynasty by Emperor Guangwu of Han.
